zh.title: 星宇航空與阿提哈德航空擴大哩程合作
zh.summary: 星宇航空與阿提哈德航空推出雙向哩程兌換及累積服務。
body: 星宇航空宣佈與阿提哈德航空深化合作，將合作範圍擴展至會員哩程計畫，推出雙向哩程兌換與累積服務。兩家航空公司的會員可使用已累積哩程，兌換對方營運航班的酬賓機票。
星宇航空表示，搭乘符合資格的航班也可累積哩程，並提供補登服務。星宇航空執行長翟健華表示，會員可經由阿提哈德航空位於阿布達比的樞紐，延伸旅程至全球超過120個目的地。

en.title: Starlux Airlines and Etihad Airways Expand Mileage Partnership
en.summary: Starlux and Etihad expand their partnership with reciprocal mileage redemption and accrual services.
body: Starlux Airlines announced an expanded partnership with Etihad Airways, extending their cooperation to member mileage programs. The airlines are offering reciprocal mileage redemption and accrual services. Members can use accumulated miles to redeem award tickets on flights operated by the other airline.

Starlux said members can also earn miles on eligible flights and request mileage credit for past travel. Starlux CEO Chai Chien-hua said members can use Etihad’s hub in Abu Dhabi to extend their journeys to more than 120 destinations worldwide.
